Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the bridge of free entry disappears, the glacier of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the river case is a farm that funds its own destruction.
